shared: Each player has a visible Moon cycling New, Waxing, Full, Waning, and Hares hit hardest at Full.
differ: Hares grow differently: buffs wiped each cycle, gains every Moon turn, or gifts at each Full Moon.

takes.label: Stats on a timer
takes.line: Hares never keep stats: their Moonlight goes out each New Moon, so you double it with Chalk-Cutter, spike, then cash the loss.
takes.look_if: big timed spikes, and buffs that expire on a schedule.

takes.label: The Moon you steer
takes.line: Every Moon turn grows Hares for good; hold the Moon or turn it early to land Full on the fight you need.
takes.look_if: permanent growth every Moon turn, and a Moon you can hold.

takes.label: The copy nursery
takes.line: Full Moons pay small lasting gifts, and Grandam of the Forms turns back-row babies into real copies of the Hares ahead.
takes.look_if: extra copies of your best Hares, grown from New Moon babies.
